description: List the BAMF UI component library so pages, artifacts, dashboards and in-chat cards you build look and behave like BAMF's own agent. Returns ui_cards components (in-chat and right-pane cards), GenUI nodes (composable panels and artifacts) and DSI page components, each with id, origin, surfaces, description, props JSON Schema, example spec and allowed actions, plus DSI design tokens and rules. Prefer these components over custom markup; check the spec with bamf.validate_ui_spec before showing or saving it. Read-only.

include_schema.description: Include propsSchema, example and $defs. Set false for a compact list.

include_tokens.description: Include DSI tokens (color, type, radius, spacing, motion) and principles.

query.description: Case-insensitive match on id, name and description.

surface.description: Only components that render on this surface.

name: bamf.list_ui_components
